name: 顾清霜
canonical_identity: 25-year-old tall lean woman with disciplined upright posture
narrow oval face, straight dark eyebrows and focused almond eyes
center-parted black hair in a high compact bun
dark-metal low crown with one horizontal pin and plain end caps
deep navy judicial robe, charcoal inner collar and silver geometric edging
single dark evidence-tool case on anatomical left/screen-right
continuity_normalization: Never mirror the evidence-tool case to anatomical right.
Keep one centered small pale vertical crown motif; do not invent readable text.
Do not add bangs, loose romantic hair, jewelry, weapons or armor.
Preserve visible five-finger hands during seal-inspection shots.
Keep robe deep navy rather than teal, bright blue or black.
